chunks: Then We destroyed the rest of them,

key_terms.الْآخَرِينَ: the rest of them / the others

ai.seo_question: Who were destroyed by God in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the sequential nature of divine punishment, where the destruction of the 'others' (the later generations or remaining disbelievers) follows the initial reckoning, underscoring the inevitability of retribution for those who persist in denial. It serves as a reminder that divine justice is comprehensive, leaving no group exempt from the consequences of their rejection of the truth. This thematic progression reinforces the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) as both immediate and cumulative.
